allocation: fresh per build; not a guarantee of cold physical pages or caches
bandwidth: modeled logical sort-buffer bytes / GPU timestamp duration; duration includes sort and directory, not CPU upload; numerator excludes directory search/threadgroup traffic; NOT measured DRAM bandwidth

comparisons.scratch_storage: gpu_private_scratch vs gpu_fresh_profiled holds in-place input/output topology constant
comparisons.staging_cache: gpu_writecombined_upload vs gpu_cached_upload holds staging/private-scratch/final-output topology constant and changes only staging cache mode
comparisons.staging_topology: gpu_cached_upload vs gpu_private_scratch changes staging/output topology, not just a cache flag

cpu: comparison sort vs single-thread stable byte radix skipping constant bytes; identical shared-buffer read layout
first_cpu_scan: first harness full-row read after construction; rotate-left-7 then wrapping-add packed key:u32/payload:u32 into a u64 starting at zero; includes row iteration and checksum computation, excludes assertion and exact row equality; separate from build wall time; not a guarantee of cold CPU caches
gpu: same GPU sort kernels and directory construction across memory modes; CPU upload populates shared input read directly by the first GPU pass, with no staging blit; pretouch charged explicitly; profiled modes retain GPU timestamp timing; unprofiled mode uses the default build

memory_modes.gpu_cached_upload: separate shared default-cache CPU-write-only staging input; private GPU scratch; separate shared default-cache final output/directory
memory_modes.gpu_fresh_profiled: shared default-cache input/output and scratch, in-place upload
memory_modes.gpu_pretouched_profiled: shared default-cache input/output and scratch, in-place upload with explicit pretouch
memory_modes.gpu_private_scratch: shared default-cache input/output, in-place upload; private GPU scratch
memory_modes.gpu_writecombined_upload: same topology as gpu_cached_upload; only CPU-write-only staging input uses write-combined caching; final output/directory remain shared default-cache

phases: submit_wait includes GPU execution; do not add GPU time to host phase sum. cleanup_other includes scratch destruction/autorelease and other unclassified host work. first_cpu_scan_ms is measured only after build wall timing ends
source_bytes: rows * 8, identical generated key/payload source for every mode
validation: expected checksum computed from the stable sorted reference outside timing; every build checks the timed scan checksum and then complete stable sorted key/payload equality outside timing
